@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+RSpec.describe WLex::Lexer, 'DSL method_missing' do
+  it 'delegates missing class methods to RuleDSL' do
+    klass = Class.new(described_class)
+
+    expect(klass.dsl.lex_tokens).to eq([])
+
+    # Call a method that is implemented on RuleDSL but not on the class
+    klass.tokens(:FOO, :BAR)
+
+    expect(klass.dsl.lex_tokens).to eq([:FOO, :BAR])
+  end
+
+  it 'raises NoMethodError when the method is not present on the class or DSL' do
+    klass = Class.new(described_class)
+
+    expect { klass.this_method_does_not_exist }.to raise_error(NoMethodError)
+  end
+end

+RSpec.describe WLex::Lexeme, '#==' do

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+RSpec.describe WLex::Lexer, 'extra behaviors' do
+  it 'emits debug logging when debug: true' do
+    stub_const('DbgLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:ID)
+      rule(:ID, /[a-z]+/)
+    end)
+
+    logger = double('logger')
+    expect(logger).to receive(:info).with(a_string_starting_with('lex:')).at_least(:once)
+
+    lexer = DbgLexer.new(debug: true)
+    lexer.instance_variable_set(:@logger, logger)
+
+    lexer.lex('abc').to_a
+  end
+
+  it 'skips tokens when the action returns nil or a non-token value' do
+    stub_const('SkipLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:NUMBER, :SKIP, :SKIP2)
+      rule(:SKIP, /x/) { |_lexer, _token| nil }
+      rule(:SKIP2, /y/) { |_lexer, _token| 'not-a-token' }
+      rule(:NUMBER, /\d+/) do |_lexer, token|
+        token.value = token.value.to_i
+        token
+      end
+    end)
+
+    lexer = SkipLexer.new
+    expect(lexer.lex('x12').map(&:to_ary)).to eq([[:NUMBER, 12, 1, 2]])
+    lexer.rewind
+    expect(lexer.lex('y7').map(&:to_ary)).to eq([[:NUMBER, 7, 1, 2]])
+  end
+
+  it 'uses an error handler that returns a token' do
+    stub_const('ErrorLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:A, :ERROR)
+      states initial: :exclusive
+      rule(:A, /a/)
+      error do |_lexer, token|
+        WLex::Token.new(:ERROR, token.value.upcase)
+      end
+    end)
+
+    lexer = ErrorLexer.new
+    expect(lexer.lex('b').map(&:to_ary)).to eq([[:ERROR, 'B', 1, 1]])
+  end
+
+  it 'raises when undefined state is begun' do
+    stub_const('EmptyLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:ID)
+      rule(:ID, /[a-z]+/)
+    end)
+
+    lexer = EmptyLexer.new
+    expect { lexer.begin(:missing) }.to raise_error(WLex::LexerError)
+  end
+
+  it 'raises when error handler returns nil' do
+    stub_const('NilErrorLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:ID)
+      states initial: :exclusive
+      rule(:ID, /[a-z]/)
+      error do |_lexer, _token|
+        nil
+      end
+    end)
+
+    lexer = NilErrorLexer.new
+    # error handler that returns nil should cause the lexer to skip the character
+    expect(lexer.lex('!').to_a).to eq([])
+  end
+
+  it 'advances the internal current_pos when skip is called' do
+    stub_const('SkipPosLexer', Class.new(described_class) do
+      tokens(:ID)
+      rule(:ID, /[a-z]+/)
+    end)
+
+    lexer = SkipPosLexer.new
+    expect(lexer.instance_variable_get(:@current_pos)).to eq(1)
+    lexer.skip(5)
+    expect(lexer.instance_variable_get(:@current_pos)).to eq(6)
+  end
+end

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+RSpec.describe WLex::Logger do
+  it 'forwards info to the underlying logger' do
+    logger = described_class.new
+    inner = double('inner')
+    expect(inner).to receive(:info).with('test info')
+    logger.instance_variable_set(:@logger, inner)
+
+    logger.info('test info')
+  end
+
+  it 'forwards error to the underlying logger' do
+    logger = described_class.new
+    inner = double('inner')
+    expect(inner).to receive(:error).with('test error')
+    logger.instance_variable_set(:@logger, inner)
+
+    logger.error('test error')
+  end
+end

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+RSpec.describe WLex::State, '#==' do
+  it 'returns true for states with same name and lexemes' do
+    lexeme_a = instance_double('Lexeme', name: :A)
+    lexeme_b = instance_double('Lexeme', name: :B)
+
+    state1 = described_class.new(:s, [lexeme_a, lexeme_b])
+    state2 = described_class.new(:s, [lexeme_a, lexeme_b])
+
+    expect(state1).to eq(state2)
+  end
+
+  it 'returns false for states with different names' do
+    lexeme = instance_double('Lexeme', name: :A)
+
+    state1 = described_class.new(:s1, [lexeme])
+    state2 = described_class.new(:s2, [lexeme])
+
+    expect(state1).not_to eq(state2)
+  end
+
+  it 'returns false for states with different lexemes' do
+    lexeme_a = instance_double('Lexeme', name: :A)
+    lexeme_b = instance_double('Lexeme', name: :B)
+
+    state1 = described_class.new(:s, [lexeme_a])
+    state2 = described_class.new(:s, [lexeme_b])
+
+    expect(state1).not_to eq(state2)
+  end
+end
